reason: A strawberry cheesecake matcha or a torched-meringue hot chocolate right at my subway exit is exactly the kind of thing I'd try and post. But on my income it's a once-or-twice treat for the photo, not a daily stop. My regular coffee place stays my regular.
objection: $8 is a lot for me, and once I've posted it I don't know if I'd come back. If it doesn't look as good as it sounds, I've wasted money I don't really have.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper or smaller version of the signature drinks, around $6, would turn it from a one-time photo into something I'd actually come back for.
